tools.name: emby-sessions
tools.description: Active Emby sessions: who is connected, on which device/client, and what they are playing right now (NowPlayingItem) with play state.
tools.filter: [.[] | {UserName, Client, DeviceName, LastActivityDate, NowPlaying: (.NowPlayingItem | if . then {Name, Type, SeriesName, SeasonName, IndexNumber, RunTimeTicks} else null end), IsPaused: .PlayState.IsPaused, PositionTicks: .PlayState.PositionTicks}]

tools.name: emby-search
tools.description: Search the Emby library for movies, series or episodes by name. Returns Id, Name, Type, Year, and for episodes the SeriesName/season/episode.
tools.filter: {TotalRecordCount, Items: [.Items[] | {Id, Name, Type, ProductionYear, SeriesName, ParentIndexNumber, IndexNumber, Path, DateCreated}]}

tools.name: emby-item
tools.description: Details of one library item by Emby Id: path, overview, media streams, dates, user data.
tools.filter: {Items: [.Items[] | {Id, Name, Type, ProductionYear, Overview, Path, Genres, DateCreated, RunTimeTicks, MediaStreams: [.MediaStreams[]? | {Type, Codec, Language, DisplayTitle}]}]}

tools.name: emby-users
tools.description: Emby user accounts (Id + Name); user Ids are needed by emby-latest.

tools.name: emby-latest
tools.description: Most recently added movies/episodes as seen by one user.

tools.name: emby-system-info
tools.description: Emby server version, name, OS, and whether a newer version is available.
